required_identity_evidence: An independently verifiable identity or organizational authority record for the named Primary role
A signed role-binding statement that includes this exact public-key fingerprint
Verification by an independent authorized reviewer, recorded with source and timestamp

closure_gates.exit_criteria: Verify an out-of-band identity/authority record and signed binding to the registered fingerprint; never infer identity from proof of possession alone.

closure_gates.owner: o2, Guardian, chain auditor, adversarial auditor
closure_gates.exit_criteria: Register four distinct secp256k1 public keys, independently bind each key to its role, and obtain each role's DER signature over the same fresh evidence envelope.
Run production verifier with all five independently trusted public keys and real signatures; persist certificate and verifier output; independently re-verify certificate and replay protection.

Keep Coinbase read-only or disabled. Any write/trading/transfer/withdrawal capability requires a separate explicit authorization, scoped credentials, risk limits, and end-to-end sandbox and live controls review.

checks: Five-party verifier requires exactly five signer identities and five signatures
DER canonical round-trip and ECDSA scalar range checks enforced
Evidence digest, protocol, nonce, and timestamp are bound into signing message
Timestamp freshness and transactional replay protection enforced
Failed signatures do not consume replay nonce
Coinbase wallet and Advanced Trade adapters remain disabled by default and tests exercise read-only behavior
external_blockers: Primary identity/role binding has not been independently established
Four additional independently authenticated signer keys and signatures have not been supplied
No production 5-of-5 certificate may be issued from ephemeral unit-test keys
scope_limits: No live Coinbase API credentials or live API calls tested
